sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233545, fetched 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: RIDB catalog for 233545 (all 33 reservable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 66 sites for tents or RVs (33 electric/water, 32 non-electric, all reservable). Catalog vehicle lengths 20-45 ft (most 35-40); 3 pull-throughs, the rest back-in. Most sites have gravel bases.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233545 ('There are 66 sites for tents or RVs'; notice 'Most campsites have gravel bases') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, reservable per site), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Swimming beach and picnic shelter. Generators and music off at 10 p.m.; alcohol and off-road vehicles (golf carts, 4-wheelers) prohibited.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233545 ('amenities like hot showers, flush toilets and a dump station'; notices), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 nights in any 30-day period; one campsite held at a time. Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 2 p.m.; no check-in after the gatehouse closes (9 p.m. Sunday-Thursday, 10 p.m. Friday-Saturday).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233545 (rules maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days', maxConcurrentStay 1; notices on check-in/out and gatehouse hours) + RIDB catalog (all family sites reservable), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 peak season (April 1 - October 31): non-electric $24, electric/water $34 a night. $7 day-use fee waived for campers.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233545/rates (2026-04-01 to 2026-10-31 Peak: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24, STANDARD ELECTRIC 34) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233545 (notice on the $7 day-use fee), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233545 (notice: 'Golden Age/Access and America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Passes are accepted at this campground and cardholders receive a 50% discount on camping fees'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the $24/$34 2026 rates and the derived 50-amp/water hookups. Added 66 sites to 45 ft with 3 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump, reservable on rec.gov with a 14-night max, the senior/access pass 50% discount. Not stated: sewer, a campground season (only staffing dates and rate seasons), fcfs, booking window; rec.gov's militaryDiscount rule flag has no wording, so military left alone.
